purpose: Teach: 投げかけ/飼料/熟練/義務付け/ステンレス/預かり/行き過ぎ/混在

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代から、社員に、根源的な問いを、投げかけ続けてきた、本当に、創業精神、大事にしてきた。
lines.en: Since your father's time, we've kept asking fundamental questions of our staff. That founding spirit—we've truly treasured it.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. Lands lightly on key words—'father,' 'questions,' 'spirit.' Quiet authority in the voice, not pushing. Eyes distant with memory. Warm but firm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業期、お父さんは、農家への、飼料事業から、始めたんですよね、すごい歴史、本当に、誇りに思っています。
lines.en: Yes. In the early days, my father started with feed for farming communities. It's extraordinary history—I'm genuinely proud of it.
lines.style: Clear and direct, but with undercurrent of reverence. Slight pause before 'extraordinary.' Warm respect coloring each phrase. Not rushed—giving weight to the legacy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 熟練の職人を、お父さんが、大事にしてきた精神、お前の代でも、絶対、引き継いでいけよ、本当に、頼むぞ。
lines.en: The spirit your father held toward skilled craftsmen—you must carry that forward in your time. Truly, I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Firmer now, with gentle urgency underneath. Lands on 'must carry forward.' Not commanding, but the weight of inheritance is clear. Eyes steady, searching.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。最近、社員、義務付けられた研修、創業者の精神を、伝える内容に、しております、本当に、お父さんの想いを。
lines.en: Yes. Lately, we've made our mandatory staff training center on conveying the founder's spirit. We're truly honoring what my father believed in.
lines.style: Assured and deliberate. Each phrase is chosen. Slight emphasis on 'convey'—showing action, not just words. Respectful, grounded in purpose.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、ステンレス、まだ、珍しかったんだぞ、覚えてるか、お前、当社、いち早く、採用した記憶、ある?
lines.en: When the company was founded, stainless steel was still rare. Do you remember? We were among the first to adopt it. Do you have that memory?
lines.style: Softer, almost intimate. Testing the memory together. Slight wonder in 'rare.' Pauses for the answer—inviting him in. Nostalgic but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業以来の、お得意様からの預かり関係、絶対、大切にしてまいります、お父さん、心配なさらないで、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The relationships with our long-standing clients since the founding—we will never stop treasuring them. Please don't worry, Father. Never.
lines.style: Steady, resolute promise. Repeats 'never' with quiet conviction—not defensive, just absolute. Warm toward the father figure. Each word placed with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代も、行き過ぎた経営判断、何度か、悩んだぞ、お前、慎重に、判断しろよ、本当に、絶対だ。
lines.en: Even in your father's era, there were times he struggled with decisions that went too far. You must judge carefully. Really, it's essential.
lines.style: Weight and gravity here. Not harsh—protective. Slight tremor of old worry. Lands on 'carefully'—urgent but not panicked. Ending firm: 'it's essential.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業期からの古参と、新人、混在する社内、本当に、活気、ありますね、お父さん、社員、財産です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Our company has a beautiful mix now—long-time staff from the founding days alongside newcomers. There's real energy. That's what matters, Father. Our people are our greatest asset.
lines.style: Warm and assured—the close of a deep conversation. Slight lift on 'beautiful mix.' Lands on 'greatest asset' with quiet conviction. Grateful tone. Breathing slightly fuller now.
